skill.name: knowledge-work-small-business
skill.description: Use when running small-business workflows — payroll planning, month-end close, weekly briefs, and growth campaigns — via plain English over connected tools like QuickBooks and HubSpot.
whenToUse: Handling money-adjacent tasks — planning payroll, month-end close, cash forecasts, tax prep
Running growth and marketing — campaigns, lead triage, content, and Canva assets
Getting a weekly or Friday brief pulling across your finance, CRM, and calendar tools
Describing a situation in plain English and letting the router pick the right workflow

keyConcepts.explanation: Three layers: 15 building-block skills that each do one thing, 15 commands that chain them into multi-step recipes, and a router that maps plain-English requests to the right workflow.
The front door — you talk in plain English ("a customer is angry", "what should I charge?") and the router figures out which workflow fits, so you never memorize command names.
Say "set me up" to run onboarding, which learns your business, pain points, and the tools you already use before recommending connections.
Skills like plan-payroll, close-month/month-end-prep, cash-flow-snapshot, margin-analyzer, and tax-prep power cash forecasts, margins, close, and tax prep, mostly via QuickBooks.
run-campaign, lead-triage, content-strategy, canva-creator, handle-complaint, and invoice-chase cover marketing, CRM, and customer care over HubSpot, PayPal, Canva, and email.
Every workflow pauses before taking action; nothing that touches money or customers happens without your explicit say-so.

gotchas: Primarily designed for Cowork, Anthropic's agentic desktop app, though it also works in Claude Code
Every step that touches money or customers pauses for your approval — you approve before it acts
It assists with workflows but does not give financial, tax, legal, or HR advice; review outputs yourself
Core tools QuickBooks, PayPal, and HubSpot power the financial and CRM workflows — connect them first
You don't need all connectors; connect one or two and the plugin tells you when adding another unlocks more
